name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Perform a dry run without pushing changes'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  merge-dev-into-features-hubs-recs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch latest changes
        run: |
          git fetch origin dev
          git fetch origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs
        id: merge
        run: |
          # Checkout the target branch
          git checkout features/hubs-recs
          
          # Attempt to merge dev
          if git merge origin/dev --no-edit; then
            echo "MERGE_SUCCESS=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Merge completed successfully."
          else
            echo "MERGE_SUCCESS=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "::error::Merge conflicts detected. Please resolve them manually."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Push changes
        if: steps.merge.outputs.MERGE_SUCCESS == 'true' && inputs.dry_run == false
        run: |
          git push origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Dry run notification
        if: steps.merge.outputs.MERGE_SUCCESS == 'true' && inputs.dry_run == true
        run: |
          echo "::notice::Dry run mode enabled. Changes were not pushed."
          git status
